notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Just another round of improvements:

[list]
[*] Computer cannon statistics now register correctly on the game's final stat screen.
[*] The final stat screen now properly displays the computer's difficulty.
[*] The game's targeting system will no longer attempt to automatically target a valid tile, but will instead display an error message. This was originally implemented to help the player, but it proved to be too disorienting.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - More bug fixes
notes.notes:
• The AI now uses cannons as intended.
• Fixed the "cannot join the game" bug.
• Fixed a bug that caused an unintended "not adjacent" error message that had extra information in it.
• Fixed a bug that caused your government selection to not save properly.
• Game names can now have a space in them.
• The Lithuanian flag now displays properly on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Enhancements and Fixes
notes.notes:
• Blank or "Unknown" flags for CPU and human players are now shown as dark blue solid flags.
• When adding CPU opponents, it will now default to the difficulty you last selected.
• Fixed a bug that caused the CPU opponents to erroneously disconnect in some cases.
• Your computer will now remember your preferred screen size on launch.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - More Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Cleaned up a few more minor bugs after streaming last night:

• You can now re-fortify tiles that have been nuked.
• AI players have received a bump in their calculated resource values. This will help them appear more aligned with human players.
• Fixed a tile in central China that was not properly linked to its neighbor.
• AI players will now use their cannons attacks as intended.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Minor bug fix:

• Fixed diplomacy flag images for AI players when it is manually selected in the game lobby.

notes.title: Patch 1.0 is live!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0 is here! Here are the final bug fixes and enhancements for the full release version:

• Fixed a bug that caused CPU player state in the game lobby to get out of sync in some circumstances.
• Fixed the displayed status of online players on your friend list.
• Fixed the instant update of player flags when updated on the title chat room.
• You can now add yourself to your friends list. Hey, why not?
• When a player leaves a full game in the game lobby, it now reappears to players looking for an open game.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 Is Finally Here!
notes.notes:
The mega update is finally here! Firmament Wars has been upgraded with a highly optimized caching system to store game data. Expect gameplay to feel much smoother and faster than ever! Along with the redesign are some updates as well:

• Literally everything should feel faster and the game should scale better in terms of supporting more concurrent players. This is where the bulk of the work went in this patch! A big deal if you decided to tell all of your friends about how cool Firmament Wars is...
• Friends lists are now stored locally on your computer. Your old friend list is gone. Sorry! It was for the best. Trust me.
• Fixed a bug in team games with AI opponents that sometimes caused games to end prematurely.
• Removed the GET troop bonuses from the game for reasons.

notes.title: Upgrading to version 0.3 - Outage Taking Longer Than Expected
notes.notes: Apologies for the extended outage. We'll be right back when everything is working as expected! The latest update came with some unexpected behavior.

notes.title: Full Release Pushed to Late August to Finish Netcode Optimization
notes.notes:
Thanks to all of the helpful feedback from players, we found several important improvements to work on! For the time being, we are finished adding maps. Since the start of Early Access on June 23rd, we have added five new maps and improved one map. We hoped to release today, however the netcode optimizations are taking longer than expected, so we will mark Firmament Wars as "full release" as soon as those changes are completed. We hope that is no later than the end of August. 

The lobby and title screen have already been full refactored, but we are still finishing up refactoring the netcode for the game mode itself. Our goal is that the game will be able to support hundreds, perhaps thousands, of concurrent players once the changes are finished.

notes.title: Update 0.1.7 released!
notes.notes:
• Attack and Split Attack now have a 1-second cooldown.
• Six new languages are now supported: French, Korean, Japanese, Turkish, Polish, and Italian.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6 Updates
notes.notes: • Localization support added for simplified Chinese, Russian, German, and Portuguese!

notes.title: New release date: 8/8/18 at 8 a.m. PDT
notes.notes: I have decided to push the release date to August 8th, 2018, at 0800 PDT in order to finish its localization into multiple languages. I plan to support at least 8 more languages and 8 more maps to the game at launch. Both of these changes will help broaden the appeal of the game to a wider audience.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5 Updates
notes.notes:
• Optimized the water animation which should considerably improve performance on older systems
• Fixed a bug that caused weapon cooldowns to activate when targeting an invalid target.
• Fixed a bug that allowed you to try targeting with weapons you haven't unlocked in the tech tree yet.
• Democracy new gains 3 instead of 2 available troops when they lose a tile.
• Fascism no longer benefits from science bonuses from barbarian huts.
• Fascism now has +1 attack from tiles for each defensive structure.
• Moved one of the possible starting points on the France map for a more balanced starting position.
• Disabled HTTP throttling that was causing some unintentional various bugs, including not ending the game properly in some circumstances.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4 Updates
notes.notes:
• Flag select menu now shows inline preview flags.
• Fixed a bug that caused a client-side state of a tile to be incorrect after eliminating a player.
• Improved filtering of all steam names and text inputs.
• Democracy now gains 2 reserve troops when they lose a tile instead of gaining +3 on the map randomly.
• You can now toggle the visibility of the flag panel in game.

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 released!
notes.notes:
Cleaned up some bug fixes:
- Fixes to team mode 
- Fixes to weapon timers.
- Fixes to displayed costs for weapons under Communism.

notes.title: Pre-release updates 6/12
notes.notes:
New updates include:
- Fixed a bug that prevented games from detecting when it's over in some circumstances.
- All weapons, cannons, missiles, and nukes, now have a cooldown of 2, 5, and 30 seconds, respectively.
- Fixed a bug that caused an off-by-one unit math error when moving into unexplored territory.
